Complete Guide to Remove Pages

PDF documents often accumulate unnecessary pages - such as blank separator sheets, outdated terms of service, redundant cover sheets, or confidential appendices that should not be shared with outside parties. TECHTIS Remove Pages makes it effortless to trim documents down to only the essential content.

With our interactive visual grid, you simply click on any page to mark it for removal. If you already know which page numbers need to be removed, type them directly into the range field for batch selection. Once confirmed, TECHTIS constructs a clean document tree omitting those pages entirely.

Since your documents never leave your local device, you can safely sanitize confidential records, financial filings, and medical histories without compromising patient or client privacy.

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Remove Pages and privacy

How to delete pages from a PDF online without registration?
Upload your document to TECHTIS Remove Pages. Click on the thumbnail cards of the pages you wish to eliminate, or type the page numbers into the deletion field. Click 'Remove Pages' to save your streamlined document instantly.
How do I remove the instruction page from my e-Aadhaar PDF?
Upload your e-Aadhaar (unlock it first if password-protected). Click on page 2 or 3 that contains the instruction text, and click 'Remove Pages'. You will get a compact PDF with only your official card.
Does deleting pages re-compress or degrade the remaining pages?
No. TECHTIS reconstructs the page tree directly in the document catalog, leaving the remaining page contents bit-for-bit identical to the original.
Can I undo or change my selection before saving?
Yes. You can toggle page selections on and off in the interactive preview workspace before finalizing your export.
Is it safe to delete pages from confidential banking or medical records?
Yes, 100%. Processing occurs exclusively in your browser memory. Your files are never sent over the internet or stored on remote servers.
Can I delete multiple non-consecutive pages at once?
Yes. You can select any combination of individual pages (e.g. pages 2, 5, 8, 12) simultaneously.
Does the resulting file have any watermarks or limitations?
Never. TECHTIS is 100% watermark-free, unlimited, and free forever.
How does removing pages affect file size?
Removing pages directly strips unneeded fonts, images, and content streams, reducing your overall PDF file size for easier emailing.
